interface.signature: def isCircle(N: int, A: List[str]) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 and N <= 10**4
preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, list) and len(A) == N and all(isinstance(s, str) and 1 <= len(s) <= 20 and s.islower() for s in A)
preconditions.description: A is a list of N lowercase strings, each with length between 1 and 20.

postconditions.description: The return value is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(any(s[-1] == t[0] for t in A if s != t) and any(s[0] == t[-1] for t in A if s != t) for s in A) and any(all(s[-1] == t[0] for t in A if s != t) and all(s[0] == t[-1] for t in A if s != t) for s in A) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The return value is 1 if and only if every string can be chained with exactly two other strings to form a circle, otherwise 0.
